items.stem: Which approach best describes transformational leadership?

options.text: Inspiring followers around a shared vision and raising their motivation
options.rationale: Correct: transformational leaders use vision, inspiration and individual development to raise motivation.

options.text: Exchanging rewards strictly for completed tasks
options.rationale: That describes transactional leadership, based on contingent reward.

options.text: Avoiding decisions and intervening only when problems escalate
options.rationale: That describes laissez-faire or management-by-exception leadership.

options.text: Enforcing rules through close supervision and sanctions
options.rationale: That is a controlling, autocratic style, not transformational.

items.explanation: Correct: transformational leaders use vision, inspiration and individual development to raise motivation.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: A project is behind schedule and over budget. Which project-control concept best quantifies the schedule position?

options.text: Schedule variance from earned value analysis
options.rationale: Correct: schedule variance (earned value minus planned value) measures the schedule position in cost terms.
Gearing is a financing measure unrelated to project schedule performance.
Contribution margin concerns profitability per unit, not project schedule.
Dividend cover is a distribution metric, not a project-control measure.

items.explanation: Correct: schedule variance (earned value minus planned value) measures the schedule position in cost terms.

items.stem: Select TWO factors that typically increase resistance to organisational change.

options.text: Fear of loss of status or job security
options.rationale: Correct: perceived personal loss is a well-documented driver of resistance.

options.text: Poor communication about the reasons for the change
options.rationale: Correct: lack of clear communication breeds uncertainty and resistance.

options.text: Early involvement of staff in designing the change
options.rationale: Participation tends to reduce, not increase, resistance.

options.text: Strong, trusted leadership of the change

items.explanation: Correct: perceived personal loss is a well-documented driver of resistance.
